introHtml: White wine bar wine is served chilled, so insulated stemless tumblers or thin-walled glassware help maintain the perfect temperature. Whether you are outfitting a company happy hour or giving branded gifts to clients, options like the 12 oz Corkcicle® Stemless Wine Cup or the 15 oz Stemless White Wine Glass keep the wine crisp. Plastic shatterproof versions are also available for outdoor events. Choose one-color or full-color imprint to match your logo.
